test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is an open-pit copper mine?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Malanjkhand.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Malanjkhand** is an **open-pit copper mine** located in the **Balaghat district **of **Madhya Pradesh**, India.
 
• It is the **largest copper deposit** in India and one of the largest in the world.
 
• The mine is owned by **Hindustan Copper Limited,** a public sector undertaking under the **Ministry of Mines,** Government of India.
 
• The mining method used in Malanjkhand is an **open pit or surface mining,** which involves the removal of overlying rock and soil to access the copper ore.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bastar** is a district in the Indian state of **Chhattisgarh,** which has significant reserves of** iron ore and limestone.** 
 
• There are **no copper mines** in Bastar.
 
• **Singhbhum** is a district in the Indian state of **Jharkhand,** which has significant reserves of **iron ore, coal, and copper.** 
 
• However, the copper mines in Singhbhum are **underground mines**, not open pit mines.
 
• **Ballari **is a district in the Indian state of **Karnataka,** which has significant reserves of **iron ore, manganese, and limestone.** 
 
• There are **no copper mines** in Ballari.
